event, set flag 1B0 and start again.
Otherwise, execution will be forcibly terminated."<FC:B4:3E>
Yamato: "Huh...? Isn't that Ai, meow?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "What's she doing, meow?"
Talk to her.
Leave her alone.
Ai: "Oh... Touya..."
Touya: "What's up? Thinking about something?"
Ai: "N-Not really..."
Touya: "..."
Touya: "?"
Ai: "...Hey."
Touya: "Hm?"
Ai: "Can I ask you something?"
Touya: "About what?"
Ai: "About you and that girl."
Touya: "That girl?"
Yamato: "She means Kasumi."
Touya: "About me and Kasumi?"
Ai: "Yeah."
Sure, I don't mind.
It's not really something I can tell people...
Ai: "Really?"
Touya: "Let's see... Where should I start...?"
Ai: "Um, how long have you two known each other?"
Touya: "Known each other...
It was when I moved into the house I live in now, so...
Ten years ago."
Ai: "Ten years ago? That would be..."
Touya: "When I was seven. Second grade."
Ai: "You remember that well? I don't even remember
what I was doing back then."
Touya: "I remember because I had trouble fitting in
and was isolated from the rest of the class.
That's when she came up and talked to me."
Ai: "Wow... That took courage.
At that age, if you did that, wouldn't people start ignoring you too,
or bullying you?"
Touya: "Yeah. But she didn't care about any of that.
She just talked to me. Said she couldn't leave me alone."
Ai: "She's kind."
Touya: "She's too softhearted.
Well, we were just kids, and there wasn't any really nasty bullying.
Through her, I soon fit in with the class.
And since we lived next door to each other,
we've known each other ever since. Though there was a time
when we stopped seeing each other..."
Ai: "Because people teased you, right?"
Touya: "Wh-How'd you know?"
Ai: "It's the usual story... You always walked to and from school together.
It had always seemed normal, so you never thought anything of it,
but your classmates teased you and you suddenly felt self-conscious."
Touya: "Urgh..."
Ai: "You stopped seeing each other because you avoided her.
Am I right?"
Touya: "...Yeah. We ended up in different classes too.
That lasted until we were in the same class again in middle school."
Ai: "Hmm... It feels like fate.
I'm kind of jealous."
Touya: "???"
Ai: "And? And then?"
Touya: "Then..."
Ai: "What's wrong?"
Touya: "Then... My dad and mom died in a terrorist attack..."
Ai: "Oh... I'm sorry..."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Hey, hey, that was around when
Touya and I met, wasn't it?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Yamato: "Touya took me in when I was just a newborn,
and we've been together ever since."
Touya: "We were both alone.
Maybe having you and Kasumi around was what kept me
from giving up on myself."
Yamato: "What's with the sudden serious talk? You're embarrassing me, meow."
Ai: "I see..."
Touya: "Come to think of it, that's when Kasumi started
fussing over me more than ever..."
Ai: "That makes her an even tougher rival..."
Touya: "Huh?"
Ai: "N-Nothing!"
Touya: "Well, after all that, we ended up at the same high school,
and that brings us up to now."
Ai: "It's like that girl's life has always been alongside Touya,
don't you think?"
Touya: "Hmm..."
Ai: "Well, I'm sure that's what she wants, but...
Have you ever done anything for her?"
Touya: "Like what?"
Ai: "Like... Taking her on a date."
Touya: "Huh?"
Ai: "No, never mind. That reaction tells me pretty much everything.
I see. She's got it rough too... Mm-hmm."
Touya: "Hey, what are you deciding all on your own?"
Ai: "All right! So I've still got a chance.
Well, I'll be off... There."
Touya: "H-Hey..."
Ai: "See you!"
Touya: "...What was that about?"
Yamato: "At least we can be sure that a love triangle
has just formed."
Touya: "?"
Yamato: "Though the problem is that the one at its center
hasn't noticed. Anyway, how long are we staying here?"
Touya: "O-Oh, yeah... Right. Shall we go too?"
Ai: "Whaaat! Come on, it's not like telling me costs you anything."
Touya: "If you want to know that badly, ask Kasumi.
It's about her too. I can't just go blabbing
about it without asking her."
Ai: "Hmm... So you do have some decency. Sort of."
Touya: "You can leave out the 'sort of.'"
Ai: "Well, in that case, I'll do you a favor
and stop asking."
Touya: "I don't really get it, but thanks, I guess."
Ai: "But... Can I ask just one question?"
Touya: "What?"
Ai: "Have you ever been on a date with her?"
Touya: "Wh-What?! O-Of course I haven't!"
Ai: "I see... Right... Got it.
See you!"
Touya: "...What was that about?"
Yamato: "At least we can be sure that a love triangle
has just formed."
Touya: "?"
Yamato: "Though the problem is that the one at its center
hasn't noticed. Anyway, how long are we staying here?"
Touya: "O-Oh, yeah... Right. Shall we go too?"
Touya: "She doesn't look like she wants company. Let's leave her alone for now."
Yamato: "You're right. She seems to be thinking about something, meow.
We shouldn't interrupt."
